cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    first = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert first.applied is True
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_harbor_keys_sharing_a_prefix_both_settle():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6", amount=18_000))
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_2", "8f3c1a9eFFFFFFFF", amount=2_000))
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 2


def test_harbor_without_header_falls_back_to_the_event_id():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", None, amount=100))
    second = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", None, amount=100))
    assert second.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 100
EOF
